comments.body: Customer import of 4.2k rows completed with 17 row errors in the residual file—acceptable. Closing.

content.text: Customer import of 4.2k rows completed with 17 row errors in the residual file—acceptable. Closing.

Importing boards from spreadsheets currently forces a fixed column map and drops unknown headers. Customers migrating from other tools need to bind CSV columns to Nimbus fields including custom fields.

Import wizard: upload CSV (max 10k rows), auto-detect headers, then a mapping UI from each column to title, description, status, assignee email, due date, or a custom field key. Unmapped columns can be ignored or attached as labels. Dry-run reports row errors before commit.
Released when sample CSVs for two common board-tool exports are in docs, failed rows download as a residual CSV, and the bulk import worker emits progress on the existing job status channel.
